{{also|''Not to be confused with [[Deconstruction for Beginners]], a mission in [[Grand Theft Auto IV]].''}}
'''Deconstruction''' is a mission in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]], accessed independently by [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] under the inspiration of sister [[Kendl Johnson]] from Carl's [[Doherty Garage|garage]] in the industrial district of [[Doherty]] in [[San Fierro]], [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]].

==Mission==
Carl goes in the garage, checking on his team, which is working on a [[Remington]]. Suddenly, [[Kendl Johnson|Kendl]] comes in, infuriated. Kendl says that the construction workers from the construction site next to the garage have been a nuisance to her, calling her names and hitting on her. [[Cesar Vialpando|Cesar]] quickly tries to go there to teach them a lesson, but Carl insists that he do it.

Carl goes to the nearby construction site to try and scare off the firm. Carl destroys six portables using a [[Dozer|bulldozer]] in less than three minutes, which is the time when [[San Fierro Police Department|cops]] arrive. After that, Carl, who is still using the bulldozer, pushes a portable toilet into a ditch, since the foreman is in the portable toilet. Carl then uses a [[Cement Truck|cement truck]] to fill the ditch with cement, burying the foreman alive.

==Script==
'''CJ''': (''enters'') Hey, homies!

'''Cesar''': What up, Carl?

'''Kendl''': (''enters'') What the fuck is going on? Do I look like a hooker to you?

'''CJ''': What?

'''Kendl''': Those assholes keep saying shit to me.

'''Cesar''': Who said this to you?

'''Kendl''': The construction workers up that hill.

'''Cesar''': (''proceeds to attack the workers'') I'm gonna fuck them up...

'''CJ''': (''stops Cesar'') No, hold up. I got this. I need to go and teach them a little respect, huh?

'''Cesar''': That's right.

'''CJ''': I been thinking about getting me some new land anyway.

'''(''Carl destroys six portables, and the foreman comes out of the portable toilet.'')'''

'''Foreman''': What's all that damned clatter?

'''(''The foreman looks around the site.'')'''

'''Foreman''': Holy crap! I didn't see nothing! (''rushes inside and locks himself up'')

'''(''Carl buries him alive using the cement van.'')'''

==Reward==
There is no monetary reward for this mission, but the missions [[Photo Opportunity]] and [[Driving School|Back to School]] are unlocked. Further, the [[Boat School]] and the [[Bike School]] are also unlocked, though access to the latter will result in a 4-star wanted level. The same is the case with the last lesson in the former, which is located in Bayside Marina, but is triggered on a small patch of land in [[Tierra Robada]].

==Trivia==
*No matter what you put in the ditch before you bury the foreman, the cutscene will always only show you burying the foreman and therefore, the thing you put in the ditch disappears.
*After this mission is completed, the spot where the foreman is buried in concrete will always be filled in and is completely driveable over.
*Despite claiming to want the construction workers' land and killing the entire team, Carl never uses the spot afterward.

==Post-mission Phone Call==
'''Jethro:''' Yo man, it's Jethro, dude!

'''CJ:''' Hey Jethro, what up?

'''Jethro:''' Well, I was talking to Cesar and, uh, don't get me wrong, dude, I mean, you're one out there dude when it comes to driving, man, but Cesar, he told us how many cars you get through dude, and me and Dwayne were like, woah!

'''CJ:''' What is your point, Jethro?

'''Jethro:''' No point, man, no point ... Just that there's an advanced driving school like, just up the road from the garage, man, like in Doherty.

'''CJ:''' Driving school? Man, exactly what you trying to say, man?

'''Jethro:''' Nothing, man, nothing! It was Dwayne's idea ... I think you're, like, y'know, cool and shit. Uh, I better go, CJ ... I will see you later!
